stem: A payment API has steady relational baseline traffic plus periodic spikes and wants lower idle overprovisioning while keeping managed relational operations.

choices.text: Use Aurora Serverless v2 with a bounded ACU range for elasticity.
Use Aurora provisioned capacity sized for peak demand at all times.
Use ElastiCache in front of a peak-sized cluster to absorb the traffic spikes.
Use fixed provisioned relational instances and schedule manual resize windows.

rationale: Aurora Serverless v2 aligns with variable relational demand by scaling compute within configured bounds. Peak-sized provisioned clusters can carry idle cost between spikes. A cache can offload repeated reads, but the relational cluster stays provisioned at peak size, so the idle cost it was meant to remove is still paid. Manual resize windows add operational overhead and can miss unexpected spikes.
